subject.title: Slack: support assistant.threads.setSuggestedPrompts for dynamic prompt suggestions

question: Should native Slack suggested prompts become a Slack-owned config/message-action surface, or should dynamic prompt suggestions stay plugin-owned through the Smart Replies / presentation host path?
rationale: Both directions are plausible, but they imply different public contracts: new Slack config/action keys versus a portable plugin presentation API, and the closed candidate PR explicitly moved behavior out of core pending host support.

options.title: Prefer plugin presentation path
options.body: Keep current default Slack seeding in core and shape dynamic prompt suggestions through Smart Replies or portable presentation host support before adding Slack-only config.

options.title: Add Slack-owned surface
options.body: Accept a new channels.slack.assistantPrompts config and Slack-specific dynamic action, with schema/docs/upgrade tests and Slack runtime proof.

options.title: Close as external-only
options.body: If maintainers confirm no OpenClaw API gap remains after host support, close this issue with a ClawHub or Smart Replies handoff.

recommendation.title: Prefer plugin presentation path
recommendation.body: Keep current default Slack seeding in core and shape dynamic prompt suggestions through Smart Replies or portable presentation host support before adding Slack-only config.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the merged Slack assistant lifecycle path and is the clearest routing owner for whether Slack-native suggested prompts should remain in core.
